content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTAMENTARY_DISPOSITIONS
content_blocks.text: I, Isaac S. Brown, of Greenwood City, State of Novaria, do hereby declare this instrument to be my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My entire estate, including all real and personal property, shall be distributed equally among my three children: Samuel Brown, Elizabeth Brown, and Daniel Brown.
